values.note: Most sites do not take larger RVs; one is suited to a long RV, one has a double table and large parking area, and there is one pull-through. Wheeled equipment must fit the spur (no overflow parking).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/kroeger-campground ('10 campsites'; 'One site has a double table and large parking area. Another is suitable for a long RV; most sites do not accommodate larger RVs. There is one pull-thru'; 'Max RV size = 25 ft'; 'Equipment with wheels ... must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No trash pickup: pack it out. Bear-safe food storage mandatory.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/kroeger-campground ('Vault Toilet (1)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'There is no trash pickup; trash must be packed out. Bear-safe food storage is mandatory'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/kroeger-campground ('Seasons of Use: Late May through September'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come only; pay on site, where available by scanning the QR code with the Recreation.gov app (Scan and Pay; download the app before arriving, cell service is limited).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165400 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site ... Scan and Pay'; one Scan and Pay unit, Not Reservable), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165400/rates (2026 First-come, First-served Season WalkInScanPay1 22; 2027 22) + FS page ('Single Site: $22 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: San Juan NF campground in La Plata Canyon, ~5 mi up CR 124 from Hesperus (US 160), on the west side of the road with the La Plata River beyond it; shaded by spruce, fir, aspen and cottonwood. Reached on 2WD gravel; CR 124 becomes 4WD farther up-canyon past the campground. Camp host. Private property adjoins. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan and Pay listing: confirmed 10 sites, max RV 25 ft (FS), one pull-through, first-come only, $22 (2026, 2027), vault toilet, potable water; added season note 'Late May through September'. Hookups left (FS silent). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: Columbine Ranger District Office (970) 884-2512 (FS campground page office block). recreation.gov's contact text gives (661) 702-1420 (the concessionaire ExplorUS, goexplorus.com).

Operator: concessionaire-run (ExplorUS per recreation.gov contact). Ownership federal stands. Website could add the recreation.gov Scan and Pay page https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165400 (FS's 'Make Reservations Here' links it, though it is first-come only).

Road: FS directions say 'Access to campgrounds is by 2WD gravel road, but, soon thereafter, the road becomes 4WD.' The Columbine RD road-status table (Oct 26, 2026) lists La Plata Canyon County Rd 124 'Open', closing '12/15 or 4 inches standing at the gate'; 'La Plata County has completed the road repair from Oct. 2025 flooding event.' The Oct 23, 2026 forest-wide flooding alert names no road here.
Status: FS 'Site Closed' (season over); no closure order names Kroeger.
Waterfront (stored not waterfront) stands: on Esri imagery the camp spurs sit west of CR 124, and the La Plata River's channel lies ~70-100 m east of the pin beyond the road and a belt of conifers.
Pin 37.37630,-108.07665 is ~41 m from the FS/recreation.gov coordinate 37.3762,-108.0771, on the campground road. OK.
